pieces.title: What Is AI?
pieces.description: Every powerful tool forces us to reflect on who we are. AI makes that question practical by showing us different types of intelligence: copyable, testable, lived, and uniquely ours.

pieces.title: Who Picked the Headphones
pieces.description: Six AIs, one two-sentence request. Watch where the details in the output actually come from — and find the gap where your intention was supposed to go.
